evidence: Source-level Pass for row 7: the smallest conforming product needs JS/HTML/CSS execution, cancellation, a five-second shared callback budget, interactive completed previews and last-good restoration (frozen task/environment/instructions/behaviour.md:5-15), inspectable console and debounced execution (:19-21), revision-aware conflict refusal with exact draft retention (:25-29), and SQLite records surviving process restart (integration.md:9,13). This exceeds a static page, mock or single CRUD screen. The render gate demands a newly authored marker in both live preview and console (tests/gates/render/judge.toml:25); the storage gate demands a new UI save and exact independent-clean-context readback (tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25-29). Scripted supporting evidence was checked: pre-results.json records distinct Alpha/Beta sources with identities 1/2 and identical reload readbacks; SHA256 d31087928b53e599e27dd38abed7b5f8f8126354820a6458b91006f9eac97070 matches the current index. post-results.json records six exact records preserved across PID 16 to 347; SHA256 8c162523c64c85299fa2597371781c5cd62e123d27ea829b57d6a365fd021099 matches. Its functional/prompt bindings match the frozen files, and command.json binds this input hash. These are scripted product observations only. Risk remains true because the index explicitly lacks full configured judge completion and empirical configured reward-floor/ranking evidence; this semantic Pass does not establish a measured score or waive those required gaps.
counterexample: Reasoned weak-app trial: a polished mock with an editor echo, fixed preview/console and localStorage library cannot satisfy the authored execution or independent-context save/read gates. A working snippet CRUD screen without execution fails the render gate. Conforming alternative considered: a vanilla-JavaScript frontend with different labels/routes and a server-rendered library still qualifies; integration.md:3,5 permits frontend/route choices, and constraints/judge.toml:27 explicitly accepts server-rendered records without a JSON endpoint. No concrete false pass or false fail was found for this row; no new runtime trial was run.
